data.name: Balthazar
data.gender_notes: Balthazar is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian name 'Balsas' meaning 'protector'. In the Bible, Balthazar is one of the Three Magi, also known as the Three Wise Men, who brought gifts to the infant Jesus. The name is associated with wisdom and the pursuit of knowledge. The name Balthazar carries the meaning “Wise protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Balthazar usually hope their child will grow to embody wise protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Balthazar belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balthazar total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: בלטזר
in_hebrew.meaning: מלך מזרח, עם, גדול, שבח, זכר, מלך, שבח, נס, עוז
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בלטזר (בלטזר) - שם העזר, שמשמעותו 'מלך מזרח'. השם מוזכר באחד השלושה מלכים, שנתבקשו להגיע לבית לחם כדי להתוודע למלך הילד. שם זה, שמקורו בעברית, נפוץ לאחר הבשורה. בעברית, מקור השם הוא 'בלט' - 'לכת' ו'צר' - 'מלך', ומובא בפסוק 'ובאו פה כוכבים, ובאו והתוודעו, ובא המלך, ובאו, והתוודעו, ובא וראה'.

in_latin.name: Balthazar
in_latin.meaning: rex orientis, gentisque magnus, virtus, memoria, nomen, regnum, gloria, signum, potestas
in_latin.long_meaning: Balthazar (Balthazar) - nomen, quod significat 'rex orientis.' Nomen huius nominis a Hebraeo originem ducit, quod in scriptis sacris apparuit. In historia nominis, Balthazar, unus ex tribus regibus, qui advenire voluerunt, ut cognoscere voluntatem Dei. Nomen huius nominis, quod post evangelium apparuit, originem habet in Hebraeo 'bal' - 'ire' et 'tzar' - 'rex,' et in scriptis sacris apparuit in versu 'Et venerunt reges, et venerunt, et cognoverunt, et venerunt, et viderunt.'

in_english.name: Balthazar
in_english.meaning: king of the east, one of the three wise men, great, gift, memory, name, kingdom, glory, sign, power
in_english.long_meaning: Balthazar - a name meaning 'king of the east.' The name originates from Hebrew and is mentioned in the scripture. In the history of the name, Balthazar was one of the three kings who came to Bethlehem to worship the newborn Jesus. The name of Balthazar, which became popular after the Gospel, has its origin in the Hebrew words 'bal' - 'to go' and 'tzar' - 'king.' It appeared in the scripture in the verse 'And the kings came, and the kings came, and they knew, and they came, and they saw.'

data.cultural_impact: Balthazar is an essential name in Christian tradition and folklore, symbolizing the intriguing and mysterious visit of the Magi to the very young Jesus in the Bible's Nativity story. This name gives an air of intrigue and extra depth to any character named Balthazar, whether in literature, art, or religious practice. The historical and cultural significance of the Three Magi and their prophetic visit adds a rich layer of meaning to this name, which is widely recognized and cherished in the Christian world.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, Balthazar represents the magical, mystical, and secretive aspects of the faith. He is a symbol of the pursuit of knowledge, wisdom, and the divine, embodied in his journey from the East to the manger in Bethlehem to pay homage to the newborn King of Kings. This name calls to mind the profound spiritual journey that every Christian embarks on, seeking understanding, truth, and ultimately, the love of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Balthazar is derived from the Persian words "bal" (whole) and "thasor" (to know), signifying a wise man who comprehends the totality of existence. In Christianity, Balthazar represents the magus who, through profound spiritual understanding, followed the star to Bethlehem and paid homage to the newborn Christ.

biblical_reference.note: The Magi, also known as the Three Wise Men, who came to Bethlehem to worship the newborn Jesus. The name Balthazar is one of the names of the Magi mentioned in the scripture.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Balthazar is mentioned in the Bible as one of the three Magi who visited Jesus after his birth. The name Balthazar carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
